{{Top|leg}}
The '''Khomm Central Population Planning''' was the department that handled the creation of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]]. Their data was stolen by the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|Null Arcs]] in order to gather enough information to stop their accelerated aging.<ref name="o66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>
